runtime_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic chest-up editorial portrait of an original adult desert solar observatory restorer in a high-desert heliostat field at cobalt blue hour, aligning a cracked mirror segment with a brass optical gauge. Frame her slightly off-center at eye level with an 85 mm portrait perspective; keep her face, both working hands, the fracture, and the gauge on one crisp focal plane while heliostat rows recede diagonally behind her. Her makeup forms a restrained polished natural balance: sheer-to-light satin complexion correction leaves fine skin texture and natural tonal variation readable; softly groomed low-arch brows retain individual hairs; a neutral taupe wash is deepest at the upper lash line and diffuses through the crease; a slim interlash line ends in a very short tapered outer extension; lashes are clean and separated; a muted rose flush stays soft on the cheeks; muted rosy-coral lip color is strongest near the inner center, fades toward a softly diffused vermilion edge, and carries a low satin-balm sheen. Eye, cheek, and lip contrast remain mutually restrained so the complexion leads the hierarchy. Use a soft neutral facial key while cobalt ambient light and warm reflected heliostat light remain environmental accents. The supplied portrait guides only this makeup placement, color distribution, and surface finish; the subject has an original facial identity. Avoid: distorted fingers, over-processed retouching, excessive HDR, 3D render look, low resolution, cartoon style, plastic-looking skin, illustration look, unrealistic hands
